# Mountain Race Shop

> Motorcycle handling diagnosis and suspension engineering workshop serving Canberra, ACT, Snowy Monaro, Bombala, Delegate, Bega Valley and surrounding NSW regions, with mountain bike suspension servicing for Snowy Mountains riders.

Mountain Race Shop diagnoses motorcycle handling problems before recommending suspension work. Motorcycle services include fork servicing, shock servicing, spring-rate and sag setup, suspension revalving, steering-head bearing service, brake pad inspection/replacement, race support and engineering analysis. Mountain bike services include selected fork and shock servicing, lower-leg and air-can maintenance, full services and setup/diagnosis subject to model and parts availability. The workshop is at 2572 Shannons Flat Rd, Shannons Flat NSW 2630, Australia. Phone: +61 420 947 505. Email: craig@mountainraceshop.com.au.

## Motorcycle workshop quotes
- Brake pad inspection: included with suspension service

Call or text Craig on 0420 947 505 for a motorcycle workshop quote. Extra wear parts, damage, coatings, shafts, tubes and unexpected repairs are confirmed before work begins.

## MTB suspension pricing
- Complete-bike removal/refit and setup/diagnosis: quoted after confirming the exact bike and suspension model

Contact Craig with the fork or shock model and serial number for a quote.

## Positioning
Mountain Race Shop uses an engineering-backed diagnostic approach: rider complaint, bike, rider weight, terrain and use are considered before recommending springs, servicing, revalving or setup changes. The business is positioned around diagnosis and technical understanding rather than generic motorcycle repair or price competition.

## Geographic service areas
Canberra and ACT; Shannons Flat; Cooma and Snowy Monaro; Jindabyne and Thredbo; Bombala and Delegate; Bega Valley and the NSW South Coast.
